method: Recompute fixture hashes, parse actual fixture bytes, verify metadata/chunk snapshots, recompute exact retrieval coverage and rendered candidates, then assess facts and citation support against supplied source passages. Model judgments are not used as factual approval.
decision: Ingestion and semantic retrieval pass this small controlled corpus. Preserve the run. Remaining observed material failures lie in answer generation and the selection/generation consistency contract. Proceed to local demo integration and representative-document smoke tests before public-release claims.
reproducibility_gap: The stored embedding profiles have requested_revision=null and resolved_revision=null. The MiniLM model name and settings are recorded, but an exact embedding revision is not established by this bundle. Pin/record the actual revision before claiming cross-machine or hosted reproducibility.
limits: Eight synthetic scenarios repeated across three formats; these are not 24 independent or representative real-world questions.
Exact required-text coverage is not precision, semantic entailment, factual accuracy or a general retrieval score.
The three access-code cases have no positive gold evidence; they are excluded from the 21/21 and 30/30 recall counts.
No OCR, scanned documents, complex tables, large corpus, latency-under-load, network server or public hosting was tested.
This suite uses installed in-process upload/search routes plus the frozen fresh-candidate generator. It does not validate the current /answer route or Streamlit generation path.
Cross-format chunking and selected evidence differ, so answer differences cannot be attributed to file extension alone.
The 141.18-second sum covers model stages only, not total ingestion/retrieval runtime or hosted latency.
Source-based project assessment is not independent human validation.
next_release_checks: Integrate the evaluated answer-generation path into the local upload demo; expose original source excerpts and preserve unapproved/model-generated status.
Keep this frozen run and known build-start hallucination, conflict-contract failure and clarity caveats in project documentation.
Pin or record the exact embedding model revision before cross-environment comparison.
Smoke-test representative user documents in the actual upload UI before repository release and free-host capacity checks.
